criticism: The functions transferProxy, approveProxy, approveAndCall, and approveAndCallcode have a potential integer overflow vulnerability. The functions calculate the total amount of tokens to be transferred or approved by adding the value and the feeSmt. If the value is greater than the maximum uint256 value, the calculation will overflow and the functions will not work correctly.

The function allocateTokens has a potential integer overflow vulnerability. The function calculates the total amount of tokens to be allocated by adding the values. If the values are greater than the maximum uint256 value, the calculation will overflow and the function will not work correctly.
